subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw stop persisting full inline systemPromptReport objects in session entries by splitting durable warning-dedupe state from heavyweight prompt diagnostics?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the permanent shape affects durable session metadata, diagnostics, warning dedupe across restarts, and upgrade semantics; automation should not choose that policy alone.

options.title: Split Compact State
options.body: Persist only the small warning-dedupe state needed across restarts and make heavyweight prompt diagnostics transient, recomputable, or stored behind a compact reference.

options.title: Keep Inline Reports Temporarily
options.body: Accept the sessions.json size cost until a broader session metadata or database migration owns diagnostics storage end to end.

options.title: Require Linked PR Expansion
options.body: Treat the open linked fork PR as partial source work and require it to address systemPromptReport semantics before it can close this issue.

recommendation.title: Split Compact State
recommendation.body: Persist only the small warning-dedupe state needed across restarts and make heavyweight prompt diagnostics transient, recomputable, or stored behind a compact reference.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across the prompt-report origin, session-store refactors, and promptRef-style mitigation needed for the policy choice.
